summary: Senior Civil Engineer with over 8 years of experience managing and executing infrastructure, commercial, and residential construction projects. Skilled in site supervision, quality control, and contractor management with a strong track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.

achievements: Supervised execution of 3 residential projects worth over SAR 45 million, delivering all within the scheduled timeline.
Led a site supervision team of 8 engineers and technicians, ensuring strict compliance with quality and safety standards.
Reduced material costs by 12% through renegotiation with suppliers and optimized delivery schedules.
Developed a digital weekly reporting system linking field progress to budget and schedule for executive review.
Participated in the design and review of structural drawings for 5 multi-story commercial buildings.
Prepared technical feasibility studies for infrastructure projects that helped secure contracts worth SAR 20 million.
Coordinated with consultants and contractors to resolve 40 technical issues during execution phases without delays.
Streamlined the monthly payment certificate review process, reducing approval time from 15 days to 7.
Conducted field soil and concrete tests and prepared quality reports for over 12 projects.
Assisted in preparing BOQ and specifications for road and bridge tenders.
Monitored foundation and waterproofing works for 3 major residential developments.

education.institution: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
education.details: Graduation project on seismic load analysis for reinforced concrete structures in the western region.
